interpretation: Coverage recovery materially increases available tail observations. ATM and P75 improve under fixed sizing, while P25 deteriorates sharply. This is a reconstructed strategy, not the frozen strategy with extra observations: only 31 of 134 previous fixed-size P25 entries remain, 60 are no longer proposed, and 43 encounter execution or inventory rejection. The experiment shows sensitivity to construction but cannot attribute the deterioration to the original signal itself. The modest combined floor-sizing improvement over fixed sizing has a paired bootstrap interval including zero.
